name: dmfaster
description: Find prospects, research companies, extract Instagram audiences, and run authorized sales workflows with DM Faster.

interface.longDescription: Connect your DM Faster workspace to research companies, browse saved lists, and extract Instagram followers, following, likers or commenters into private prospect lists. Inspect exact saved counts and settled credit costs; profile enrichment is separately charged. Plan campaigns with exact audience previews and run campaign controls on explicit instructions within your granted permissions.
defaultPrompt: Find companies that match my ideal customer profile.
Extract Instagram followers and report the saved list and final credit cost.
Show my saved prospect lists and help me choose whom to contact.
